title: The Cold Deadline
author: Petra Ravensworth
blurb: Astrid Underhill, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
